We are seeking a client-focused professional who can drive strategic account growth while building strong executive relationships and identifying new opportunities within existing client portfolios.

The role requires a strong ability to engage with senior stakeholders, understand client business priorities, and position digital, AI-enabled, and cloud-native solutions that deliver measurable business value.

The ideal candidate will combine business acumen, relationship management, and collaboration with internal teams to expand client partnerships and support successful delivery outcomes. Mission: A high intensity account growth leader who will deliver double-digit YOY growth at one or more key accounts.

Will position Nagarro with CXOs as the strategic partner for AI transformation. Will systematically expand the breadth and depth of the engagement.

Outcomes: Grow assigned portfolio by 15%+ YOY Achieve revenue targets, in conjunction with the account''s Custodian of Client Success, through structured account planning, shaping CXO agenda, working with procurement, and collaborating within Nagarro to identify and sell expanded offerings.

Establish and maintain a "seat at the top table for AI" in the managed account(s) in partnership with AI for Change advisors and capability leads. Procure public testimonials and references from the client(s) about the quality of Nagarro 's work.

Has at least 5 years of key account leadership or similar focused experience with a 20+ million account for a well-known professional services firm with a strong account expansion track record. Can credibly engage client CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and business heads and build warm relationships.

AI fluency in an industry context - Can hold a value-led conversation about AI transformation in at least one vertical. Deal shaping and commercial acumen - Can construct and defend a business case. Comfortable in procurement and legal negotiations.

Collaborative operator - Works constructively with engineering and capability teams and earns their trust and support. Low ego, high accountability. Disclaimer: Nagarro is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

All qualified applicants will be afforded equal employment opportunities without discrimination based on race, creed, color, national origin, sex, age, disability, or marital status. We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight.

We work on a scale across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (18000 plus experts across 39 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in! Originally posted on Himalayas

We are looking for an experienced AH Dispatcher to join our operations team and support our overnight transportation activities. This role is primarily focused on OTR operations (80%) , with occasional drayage coordination (20%) .

The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of managing drivers, customer communication, and load execution in a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities Dispatch and manage OTR truck operations, ensuring on-time pickup and delivery. Monitor shipments and proactively resolve service issues to keep freight moving.

Communicate with drivers regarding routes, appointments, delays, and operational updates. Coordinate load assignments and optimize driver utilization. Track driver Hours of Service (HOS) and ensure ELD compliance. Work with customers, brokers, and carriers to provide shipment updates and resolve operational challenges.

Maintain accurate load information and documentation within the TMS. Assist with drayage operations when needed, including port appointments and container movement coordination. Escalate service failures and provide timely solutions to minimize disruptions. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless day-to-day operations.

Working conditions: Work schedule: Monday – Friday 8:00 PM – 4:00 AM PST Competitive Salary in USD Remote mode of work 10+ business days of paid time off Team building and corporate events Equipment provided A supportive team Requirements 2+ years of dispatch experience in the trucking/logistics industry. Strong background in OTR dispatching .

Drayage experience is a plus. Experience using a Transportation Management System (TMS); familiarity with PortPro, Trillium, or Geotab is highly preferred. Hands-on experience with ELD platforms such as Samsara, Motive , or similar systems.

Experience working with customers and freight platforms such as Amazon, CH Robinson, Uber Freight , or similar. Understanding of Hours of Service (HOS) regulations and transportation compliance. Excellent communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills. Ability to multitask and make decisions in a fast-paced environment.

Professional English communication skills, both written and verbal. Originally posted on Himalayas

4–6+ years of proven experience in logistics, supply chain, or transportation management, with a clear track record of owning outcomes and exceeding targets independently.
Hands-on experience booking, managing, and negotiating with trucking and freight carriers.
Exposure to CRM or TMS platforms, with the ability to quickly adopt new operational tools.
A sharp, proactive problem-solving mindset. You identify issues before they surface, make decisions with incomplete information, and act without waiting to be told.
Exceptional organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
You follow up, follow through, and keep complex workflows moving across multiple orders simultaneously.
Strong negotiation skills and stakeholder communication.
You can influence up, down, and across an organization with clarity and confidence.
Demonstrated ability to lead informally by mentoring junior colleagues, setting standards, and elevating the people around you without needing a formal management title.
A highly self-directed and reliable working style, with the maturity to manage your own workload while contributing to a fast-moving, collaborative team.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, as well as proficiency across the full Microsoft Office Suite or Google Workspace.
Fluency in English is required.
Own the end-to-end logistics process across the United States, making sharp, well-reasoned decisions to keep orders on track across quality, speed, fill rate, communication, and cost.
Lead value engineering initiatives related to transportation, identifying structural opportunities to improve order profitability and delivery performance at scale, not just one shipment at a time.
Negotiate with nurseries, suppliers, and transport partners at a senior level, securing advantageous terms while strengthening the strategic relationships that keep the supply chain resilient.
Manage a high volume of active orders simultaneously with precision, following up diligently, anticipating problems before they escalate, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
Communicate proactively with upper management by surfacing risks and wins early, escalating issues with full context, and driving resolution rather than waiting for direction.
Resolve post-order issues thoroughly and systemically by diagnosing root causes, implementing corrective action, and closing the loop so problems do not recur.
Mentor and develop junior logistics specialists by sharing your expertise, raising team standards, and stepping in as an operational lead when upper management needs support.
Drive process improvement across the logistics function by identifying efficiency gaps, proposing data-informed solutions, and helping implement changes that protect revenue and scale effectively.
Support senior leadership with strategic logistics initiatives and ad hoc priorities as they arise.
Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Deep familiarity with logistics, customs brokerage, and import/export compliance.
Background in the landscaping, horticulture, or wholesale plant materials industry.
Proven experience formally or informally mentoring junior team members in a logistics or supply chain environment.
Work Location: Remote

Import\-Export Coordinator
Established in 1927, SICPA is a Swiss private technology company that supports the effective governance and long\-term prosperity of nations.
SICPA sets the pulse of sovereignty, enabling governments to protect their citizens, sovereign assets, and economies. Best known for securing the majority of the world’s banknotes, SICPA operates across five continents. Today, our platform for sovereignty delivers integrated solutions safeguarding revenue mobilisation, natural resources, health, and brand protection as well as digital sovereignty and secure public services.

Coordination of sales orders flows, completion of transactions from quotations to deliveries including invoicing and customs clearances, master data maintenance
Coordination of the shipments process including shipping documentation and monitoring, communication of the status and delays, maintenance of import\-export files according to the regulations and policies
Record and validate shipments through certification/verification bodies when required
Perform customs classification and determination of origins for shipped goods, according to free trade agreements or non\-preferential origin regulations
Set\-up Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) with forwarders and partners
POC for operational customers activities, ensuring a high quality of service
Communication with customers, partners including freight forwarders, transporters and customs authorities is key

Technical training in exports. Federal Diploma in exportation is a plus.
Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar position
Knowledge of international trade and customs regulations
Ability to work under pressure and strict deadlines
Rigorous, flexible, with good communication skills
Strong team player and customer oriented
Strong command of SAP (module SD and MM, GTS is a plus)
Fluent in French and English, Spanish is a plus
